page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-384-metal is a bare-metal server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 384 dedicated virtual CPUs and 3072.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include local storage or integrated graphics processing units, and it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without virtualization overhead or resource contention. With 3072.0 GB of RAM, the server is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the bare-metal architecture maximizes resource density, making it suitable for large-scale deployments where virtualization layers would introduce latency or overhead. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, massive data analytics pipelines, and memory-heavy scientific simulations.
